textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: oak bookcase, 1.9 m wide, 1.8 m tall, four shelves packed with about a hundred leather-bound books, a few leaning or stacked flat
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: About a hundred books as bevelled blocks sharing one material (colour picked per book): no titles, raised bands, headbands or individual wear, and all stand square. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs, nails or tool marks are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only. Game mesh spends 12 triangles on every book, including hidden faces; UVs are several hundred small islands.
